title: COLORLESS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a cosmic disaster drains all color from the world and humanity has become a population of mutants, a lone investigator named Avidia uses his wits and an unusual gun to track down the last hidden traces of color. He meets a girl who may be the key to restoring what was lost, and is drawn into conspiracies that database tags tie to a cult.
life_message: Beauty and meaning are worth searching for and protecting even in a ruined world.
